summary: Tested new Onboarding Wizard backend endpoints + light frontend smoke. Created /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_wizard.py with 19 tests covering GET /api/onboarding/suggested-groups, POST /api/onboarding/complete, idempotency, badges/points, location_visibility=private wipe, plus regression smoke on auth/admin/groups/legacy onboarding endpoint. All 19 backend tests PASS. Frontend smoke: demo-logged-in as frankie via /api/auth/demo-login, seeded yb_token+yb_user into localStorage, navigated to /onboarding — Step 1 'Welcome to YouBelong' renders correctly with butterfly mascot, progress bar 'Step 1 of 6', body copy, and 'Get Started' button (testID onb-next present). No red screen errors. All starter groups (Sydney Locals, New Friends, Pet Lovers, Classic Cars, Gardening, Walking & Trails, Coffee Lounge Crew) auto-created and idempotent. Interest matching confirmed: Pet Lovers ranks above Classic Cars for frankie (interests include 'Pets').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5595 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Future split into modules (auth, onboarding, groups, admin, community) would help maintainability. Not a regression of this PR.

onboarding_complete_full adds 10 or 15 points unconditionally on every call (not gated on first-time completion), so a repeated POST keeps inflating points even though the badge is idempotent. Idempotency tests still pass because they only assert no duplicate badges/memberships, but points drift on retries. Consider gating on 'onboarding_completed' flag before awarding points.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates fresh TEST_onb_<uuid8> signup users (prefixed for easy cleanup). Starter groups are seeded by the endpoint itself on first call and are idempotent across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding wizard endpoints are fully working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_wizard.py covers all 7 requested cases plus regression smoke. Note that /api/notifications/{user_id} (not /api/users/{user_id}/notifications) is the correct path for fetching a user's notifications. Frontend /onboarding requires yb_token + yb_user (JSON-stringified) in localStorage to render; direct hard nav also works after auth seeding (use window.location.assign for SPA-friendly nav).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures to root-cause. Minor observation only: points accumulate on repeated /onboarding/complete calls because awarding is not gated on prior completion. Flagged under critical_code_review_comments for main agent to decide whether to address.
